name: Pathiri with Chicken Curry
instructions: 1. Prepare the dough by adding boiling water and salt to the rice flour, kneading until soft, then rolling into thin, round discs and cooking on a flat pan without oil.
2. For the curry, heat coconut oil, temper mustard and fennel seeds, then sauté onions, ginger-garlic paste, and green chilies.
3. Add turmeric, chili, and coriander powders, then add the chicken pieces and cook until browned.
4. Pour in coconut milk and a little water, simmer until the chicken is tender and the gravy thickens.
5. Finish with a sprinkle of garam masala and fresh curry leaves before serving hot with the prepared pathiri.
description: Pathiri is a signature dish of the Mappila (Malabar Muslim) community in Northern Kerala. It is culturally significant, often prepared during Ramadan, weddings, and festivals, symbolizing the deep-rooted culinary heritage of the Malabar coast.
